title: Existence of a morphism completing the supplied first two maps to a distinguished triangle.
statement: Existence of a morphism completing the supplied first two maps to a distinguished triangle.

proof.text: Complete the supplied lf to a distinguished triangle (LX,LY,K,lf,b,c) by TR1. Keep the target retraction stage sY0 supplied by huY. MS2 lifts T.mor1 against sY0. Apply the common-stage clause of huX to the resulting source denominator s to obtain t mapping to both s and the original retraction stage. Define alpha=F(a) followed by rX and fprime=d followed by the lifted map. Cone naturality proves the retraction identity for alpha. The common-stage factorization, hf, and the target retraction identity prove F(fprime) followed by rY equals alpha followed by lf.

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-derived-fixed-cone-hom-colimit] for the fixed cone, the refined source denominator t and the fixed target stage sY0. This gives a third denominator sZ, gprime and r with a second-square equation and Hom(K,W) to the third denominator Hom-colimit bijective for every W.

source.place: Lemma 05SC, LF clause, dual of the RF proof

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-essentially-constant-pro-hom-colimit] to the supplied third cone uZ. Compose its canonical Hom-colimit bijections with those of the fixed cone. The representative equation identifies the composite with precomposition by p=uZ(sZ) followed by r. Surjectivity for W=LZ supplies q with p followed by q the identity. Injectivity for W=K gives q followed by p the identity, so construct e:LZ isomorphic to K with hom p.

source.place: Lemma 05SC, LF clause, dual of the RF proof

proof.text: The second denominator square and hg give lg followed by uZ(sZ)=uY(sY0) followed by F(gprime). Postcompose with r and use the second-square retraction equation and hrY to conclude lg followed by e.hom=b. Set lh=e.hom followed by c. The identities at LX and LY together with e form a triangle isomorphism to the fixed distinguished cone. Transport distinguishedness along it by TR1.

theorem leftDerived_value_triangle_extension_core
    {C : Type u} {D : Type uD} [Category.{v} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C]
    [CategoryTheory.IsTriangulated C]
    [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ] [Preadditive D]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive] [Pretriangulated D]
    [CategoryTheory.IsTriangulated D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    (S : MorphismProperty C)
    (hS : S.IsSaturatedTriangulatedMultiplicativeSystem)
    (T : Triangle C) (hT : T ∈ distTriang C)
    (LX LY LZ : D)
    (hX : F.IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedValue S hS T.obj₁ LX)
    (hY : F.IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedValue S hS T.obj₂ LY)
    (hZ : F.IsTriangulatedLeftDerivedValue S hS T.obj₃ LZ)
    (uX : (Functor.const (S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁)).obj LX ⟶
      MorphismProperty.Over.forget S ⊤ T.obj₁ ⋙ Over.forget T.obj₁ ⋙ F)
    (uY : (Functor.const (S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂)).obj LY ⟶
      MorphismProperty.Over.forget S ⊤ T.obj₂ ⋙ Over.forget T.obj₂ ⋙ F)
    (uZ : (Functor.const (S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃)).obj LZ ⟶
      MorphismProperty.Over.forget S ⊤ T.obj₃ ⋙ Over.forget T.obj₃ ⋙ F)
    (huX : ∃ s₀ : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁, ∃ r : F.obj s₀.left ⟶ LX,
      uX.app s₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 LX ∧
        ∀ s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁, ∃ t : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁,
          ∃ a : t ⟶ s₀, ∃ b : t ⟶ s,
            F.map b.left = F.map a.left ≫ r ≫ uX.app s)
    (huY : ∃ s₀ : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂, ∃ r : F.obj s₀.left ⟶ LY,
      uY.app s₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 LY ∧
        ∀ s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂, ∃ t : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂,
          ∃ a : t ⟶ s₀, ∃ b : t ⟶ s,
            F.map b.left = F.map a.left ≫ r ≫ uY.app s)
    (huZ : ∃ s₀ : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃, ∃ r : F.obj s₀.left ⟶ LZ,
      uZ.app s₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 LZ ∧
        ∀ s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃, ∃ t : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃,
          ∃ a : t ⟶ s₀, ∃ b : t ⟶ s,
            F.map b.left = F.map a.left ≫ r ≫ uZ.app s)
    (lf : LX ⟶ LY) (lg : LY ⟶ LZ)
    (hf : ∀ (s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁) (s' : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂)
        (f' : s.left ⟶ s'.left),
        s.hom ≫ T.mor₁ = f' ≫ s'.hom →
          uX.app s ≫ F.map f' = lf ≫ uY.app s')
    (hg : ∀ (s : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂) (s' : S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃)
        (g' : s.left ⟶ s'.left),
        s.hom ≫ T.mor₂ = g' ≫ s'.hom →
          uY.app s ≫ F.map g' = lg ≫ uZ.app s')
    : ∃ lh : LZ ⟶ (shiftFunctor D (1 : ℤ)).obj LX,
      Triangle.mk lf lg lh ∈ distTriang D
